questions.question: Sami asks Mina: 'What is the key to a successful veneer?' Mina answers:
options: Only the quality of the ceramic
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Preparation and adhesion are the keys to success.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll focus on these two steps.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to choose between ceramic and composite veneers?' Mina answers:
options: The choice depends on the patient's needs and budget
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Ceramic is more durable, composite is cheaper and faster.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll present both options.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the ideal preparation thickness for a ceramic veneer?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A preparation of 0.3 to 0.7 mm is recommended.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll respect this thickness.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to choose the shade of a veneer?' Mina answers:
options: With a shade guide under neutral light
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A shade guide under neutral light is the reliable method.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll use the Vita scale.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the translucency of a veneer?' Mina answers:
options: The ability to allow light to pass through
The white color of the veneer
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Translucency gives a natural appearance to the veneer.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll choose a translucent ceramic.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to prevent veneer debonding?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Following the adhesion protocol is essential.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll follow the protocol carefully.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is a wax-up in aesthetics?' Mina answers:
options: A wax model of the final result
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The wax-up allows visualization of the final result before preparation.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll do a wax-up for my patients.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What is a mock-up?' Mina answers:
options: A resin simulation on the patient's teeth
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The mock-up allows the patient to visualize the result on their own teeth.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll always do a mock-up.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'When should a light-cure adhesive system be used?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Light-cure offers better control for veneers.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll use light-cure.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What are the advantages of composite veneers?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Composite veneers are an economic alternative.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll offer both options.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the disadvantages of ceramic veneers?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Ceramic is more expensive and more fragile.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll inform the patient of the disadvantages.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a cracked veneer?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Small cracks can be repaired.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll evaluate the possibility of repair.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the importance of tooth preparation for veneers?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Preparation is crucial for retention and aesthetics.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll prepare the teeth carefully.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage a poorly fitting veneer?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A poorly fitting veneer must be redone.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll send it back to the laboratory.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the Vita scale in aesthetics?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The Vita scale is used to choose tooth shade.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll use the Vita scale.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage spaces between teeth in aesthetics?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Small spaces can be filled with composite or veneers.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll propose composite to close the diastema.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'When to use whitening before veneers?' Mina answers:
options: When teeth are yellow or stained
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Prior whitening allows choosing a lighter shade.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll offer whitening first.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage tetracycline-stained teeth in aesthetics?' Mina answers:
options: Veneers or crowns, as whitening is ineffective
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Tetracycline stains are intra-dentinal and require veneers or crowns.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll offer veneers to this patient.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What are the signs of a successful veneer?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A successful veneer combines harmony, natural color, and fit.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll evaluate all these criteria.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage an asymmetrical smile before veneers?' Mina answers:
options: An orthodontic assessment is necessary first
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Orthodontics corrects asymmetry before veneers.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll do an orthodontic assessment.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the importance of polishing veneers?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Polishing improves aesthetics and hygiene.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll always polish veneers.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'How to manage patients with a gummy smile?' Mina answers:
options: Aesthetic periodontal treatment is often necessary
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'A gummy smile is treated with gingivectomy or periodontal treatment.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll refer to a periodontist.'

questions.question: Sami asks: 'What is the smile line?' Mina answers:
options: The curve of the incisal edge when smiling
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'The smile line should be harmonious.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll always check the smile line.'

questions.question: Sami wonders: 'What is the importance of prior aesthetic analysis?' Mina answers:
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Prior aesthetic analysis is essential.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll always do an aesthetic analysis.'

questions.question: Sami, after mastering veneers with Mina, says: 'I'm ready to take on all aesthetic challenges!' Mina concludes: 'Mastery of veneers is...'
options: The foundation of the art of the smile
questions.explanation: 🐆 Mina explains: 'Mastery of veneers is the foundation of the art of the smile.' 🦅 Sami: 'I'll continue to improve.'
